title: Chicken mango salsa bowl
summary: Chicken mango salsa bowl is a mexican dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and mango, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook skinless chicken breast fillets for Chicken mango salsa bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm little gem lettuce alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss mango with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Chicken mango salsa bowl straight away. Taste Chicken mango salsa bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
